notes.title: Trading Cards Available Now!
notes.notes:
Community items added.
Enjoy badges, trading cards, backgrounds, and emoticons!

notes.title: Combat mode and Korean language was added.
notes.notes:
-Combat mode, which was a beta mode, has been officially added.
-Korean language was added.

[Bug Fixes]
Fixed that TAIYAKI girl kept attacking infinitely in combat mode.
Fixed that Water Jackal's order of action was wrong when she attacked.
Fixed that the experience number and the bar displayed at the bottom of the screen are not correct.
Fixed that the number of magic items can be more than 2 when starting combat mode after taking over the magic items.
Fixed the text in the Trider event.
Fixed that Riva was hitting the question block instead of the sword in the Dark witch: COMBAT.
Fixed a bug in the Gohan Coin Gacha in Combat Mode where the button could be operated while the coin was being acquired.

notes.title: "Combat Mode" has been released in beta!
notes.notes:
Added "combat mode" when playing the game from the beginning in the beta version. The difficulty is high, but I hope you enjoy the Brave Dungeon in a new way.

notes.title: Fix full screen mode.
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where the full screen display would be strange with the update. However, We do not know it in my environment, so if you have any problems, please try it.
